cash_engine.detail: The cash engine fell 70% from its 2015-12-31 peak to its 2023-12-31 trough and has since regained that peak — a cyclical engine, not a broken one.

stress.detail: Owner earnings stayed inside the lines this layer draws on the test it could run — the 2022 rate shock took owner earnings 42% below the prior peak (2022-12-31) and it came back. (Not tested: no annual period covers 2020.)

predictability.detail: This business resists valuation: annual revenue growth is typically 16 points away from its 16%/yr average and the operating margin is typically 9 points away from its 22% average — what cannot be valued must be avoided however cheap it looks.

financing.detail: The financing side is not comfortable: debt due within twelve months are 0.62x cash plus a year of owner earnings. (Not measured: no price history and share-count series to compare across a drawdown.)

concentration.detail: This filer does not tag customer concentration, so this layer cannot see it — and silence here is not safety (§3.7); the cash-engine probe is what catches the same fragility by another route.
